title: A prime minimal over an associated prime plus (x) is associated to M/x^nM for some n
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (a Noetherian commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$) and let $M$ be a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. An *associated prime* of an $R$-module $N$ is a prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ for which there is an element $z\in N$ with $\operatorname{Ann}_R(z):=\{a\in R: az=0\}=\mathfrak p$; $\operatorname{Ass}_R(N)$ is the set of them. Let $x\in\mathfrak m$, let $\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Ass}_R(M)$, and let $\mathfrak q$ be a prime ideal of $R$ that is minimal over the ideal $\mathfrak p+(x)$ (that is, $\mathfrak p+(x)\subseteq\mathfrak q$ and no prime ideal $\mathfrak q'$ satisfies $\mathfrak p+(x)\subseteq\mathfrak q'\subsetneq\mathfrak q$). Then there is an integer $n\ge1$ with $\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Ass}_R(M/x^nM)$, i.e. some $w\in M/x^nM$ has $\operatorname{Ann}_R(w)=\mathfrak q$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0CN5 (lemma-inherit-minimal-primes, line 17961); associated primes as in Definition Tag 00LA (definition-associated, line 15108)

proof.text: Choose z with annihilator p using isAssociatedPrime_iff. Apply Mathlib Artin-Rees to N=Rz and I=(x); take n=c+1, so x^n M intersect N is contained in xN.

Write w for the image of z in M/x^n M and A=Ann(w). If r kills w, then rz lies in x^n M intersect N, hence rz=xaz for some a. Thus r-xa belongs to p, proving A is contained in p+(x). Also p is contained in A and x^n belongs to A.

Since A is contained in p+(x), A is contained in q. Any prime q-prime between A and q contains p and x^n, hence x, so contains p+(x). Minimality of q over p+(x) gives q-prime=q. Thus q is minimal over the colon ideal A. Mathlib Submodule.exists_eq_colon_of_mem_minimalPrimes realizes q as the annihilator of an element of M/x^n M; isAssociatedPrime_iff concludes.
